title: DevOps Engineer
description:
**JD – DevOps Engineer**

Netstratum is a global product development company specializing in custom software and enterprise IT services. With teams across ten global locations, we combine local insight with global expertise to deliver innovative, purpose\-driven solutions.

As a leader in telecom tech, we build secure, high\-performance Unified Communication Systems used by Tier\-1 providers, enterprises, and governments. Our in\-house AI platform is built for scale, security, and real\-world impact.

Join a vibrant, diverse team working on cutting\-edge projects in telecom, AI, IoT, and digital transformation \- within a fast\-paced, learning\-focused environment.

**Location:** Kochi, Kerala

**Experience:** 4\+ years

**Salary:** As per Industry Standards

**Employment Type:** Full Time

**Job Code: 092026/02**

**Job Description:**

Netstratum is looking for an experienced **DevOps Engineer** to support our development and operations teams and ensure the smooth delivery and operation of our software solutions. The ideal candidate should have strong hands\-on experience with **Kubernetes, Terraform, Jenkins, Argo CD, Git, Zabbix, SolarWinds, Grafana**, and solid networking knowledge. The role requires experience across cloud infrastructure, container orchestration, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, monitoring, and production operations.

**Responsibilities:**

* Design and implement technology solutions that enable the business.
* Develop software tools and automation to support DevOps responsibilities and CI/CD product integration.
* Lead and collaborate with teams in an Agile development cycle.
* Automate and standardize infrastructure deployment, configuration, and system administration using Python, Terraform, Ansible, and other automation tools.
* Build, manage, and support containerized environments using Docker and Kubernetes.
* Develop and maintain CI/CD and GitOps workflows using Jenkins, Argo CD, Git, and GitHub.
* Support cloud infrastructure across Azure and AWS environments, including AKS, EKS, VPC/VNet, Key Vault, and Secrets Management.
* Monitor infrastructure availability, performance, and capacity using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Zabbix, SolarWinds, Loki, Tempo, and OpenTelemetry.
* Work with Kafka and related messaging infrastructure where required.
* Take proactive steps to improve infrastructure availability, reliability, and performance.
* Fully support, configure, maintain, and upgrade server and Linux\-based infrastructure.
* Support, update, and administer third\-party applications, including SolarWinds for network monitoring and management.
* Proactively ensure high levels of system and infrastructure availability.
* Identify potential security vulnerabilities and affected hardware/software versions and apply appropriate updates and fixes.
* Troubleshoot issues across development, staging, and production environments and perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
* Support production operations, including Incident Management, Performance Tuning, High Availability, and issue resolution.
* Work with team members, decision makers, and stakeholders to define business requirements and system goals and identify technology\-based solutions.
* Evaluate the effectiveness and efficiency of existing systems and implement strategies and toolsets to improve them.

**Desired skills:**

* Strong hands\-on experience with **cloud platforms**, including Azure and AWS, with exposure to **AKS, EKS, VPC/VNet, Key Vault, and Secrets Management**
* Strong hands\-on experience with **containerization and orchestration** using Docker and Kubernetes
* Demonstrated experience with **CI/CD and GitOps**, including Jenkins, Argo CD, Git, and GitHub
* Proven expertise in **Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation** using Terraform and Ansible
* Hands\-on experience with **monitoring and observability tools**, including Prometheus, Grafana, Zabbix, SolarWinds, Loki, Tempo, and OpenTelemetry
* Experience working with **Kafka** for messaging and event\-driven systems
* Extensive knowledge and administration experience with **Linux operating systems**
* Proficiency in **scripting and programming** using Bash/Shell and Python; knowledge of Java is an added advantage
* Strong understanding of **networking concepts**, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Routing, VLAN, NAT, VPN, IPSec, Firewalls, and Load Balancing
* Practical experience with **virtualization technologies**, including VMware, Hyper\-V, and KVM
* Strong experience in **production operations**, including Incident Management, troubleshooting, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Performance Tuning, and High Availability
* Strong ability to diagnose and resolve technical issues across development, staging, and production environments
* Experience monitoring infrastructure availability, performance, and capacity and proactively addressing reliability and performance issues
* Good analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills
* Ability to collaborate effectively with development, operations, and other technical teams

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Kochi, Kerala: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Experience:

* DevOps: 4 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: Devops Engineer
description:
We are looking for a skilled and motivated **DevOps Engineer** with 2–3 years of hands\-on experience to join our technical team in Kochi. \[Only need Keralites]

The ideal candidate should have practical experience in **Linux, AWS/Cloud, Docker, CI/CD, Git, automation, and infrastructure management**. You will work closely with development and operations teams to automate deployments, improve system reliability, and maintain scalable infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, implement, and maintain **CI/CD pipelines** for application deployment.
* Manage and troubleshoot **Linux servers and cloud infrastructure**.
* Work with **AWS services** such as EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, RDS, CloudWatch, and ELB.
* Build and maintain Docker containers and containerized applications.
* Implement and maintain CI/CD using tools such as **Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI/CD**.
* Manage source code repositories using **Git/GitHub/GitLab**.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration using **Terraform and/or Ansible**.
* Monitor application and infrastructure performance using tools such as **Prometheus, Grafana, or CloudWatch**.
* Troubleshoot deployment, networking, server, and application\-related issues.
* Implement security best practices for cloud infrastructure and deployments.
* Collaborate with developers to improve application deployment and release processes.
* Maintain technical documentation for infrastructure, deployments, and operational procedures.
* Participate in incident management, root\-cause analysis, and production support.

Required Skills

* 2–3 years of hands\-on experience in **DevOps / Cloud / Infrastructure Engineering**.
* Strong knowledge of **Linux administration and troubleshooting**.
* Good understanding of **AWS cloud services**.
* Practical experience with **Docker**.
* Good knowledge of **Git and version control**.
* Experience creating and managing **CI/CD pipelines**.
* Working knowledge of **Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI/CD**.
* Knowledge of **Terraform and/or Ansible**.
* Basic understanding of **networking concepts** – TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, SSH, firewalls, load balancing, etc.
* Experience with monitoring and logging tools.
* Good scripting knowledge in **Bash, Python, or similar languages**.

Pay: Up to ₹1,000,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person
